name: Single-pole circuit breaker
summary: A circuit breaker interrupts one pole of a circuit.
description: A circuit breaker interrupts one pole of a circuit. In an expanded schematic the remaining conductors, neutral and protective conductor are drawn separately; the single-pole image does not describe a complete supply arrangement.
readingNotes: Count the protected and switched poles independently of the circuit phase count.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A one-line feeder symbol can represent a multipole device; a single-pole schematic element represents one actual pole.
